Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the note. I’m Meredith from Acme Procurement. Per our vendor policy, we need the following completed before any executive-level demo or PoC access is granted:

- Executed mutual NDA (we can use either party’s template; we prefer DocuSign)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached)
- SOC2 report or letter of attestation covering hosting + data handling (latest available)
- Point-of-contact for technical intake (name + email)

I’ve attached the questionnaire and our NDA template for convenience. Please upload completed docs to the portal: https://vendor-onboard.acmehealth.com/form/ACME-7782.

If you can get the signed NDA and the questionnaire uploaded by EOD Friday (7/24), we’ll prioritize scheduling. Otherwise we’ll need to move the exec slot until intake completes.
